notes.notes:
Dear students and concerned parents! 

We want to make you aware of several changes to the school's development plan, which, however, won't stop you from getting the most out of your education and experience at Gravewood High. 

The long-awaited full release of Gravewood High is just around the corner! At last, you'll discover all the mysteries of the creepy school, and just who Mr. Hyde is and why he does what he does. 

We have combined two of the smaller levels into a larger one to optimize the development process, give you access to new content as soon as possible, and implement all the ideas we have for the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37767751/40e8455cff4ffa83e6e6a980b6e5c86ec23219ff.jpg[/img]

What will be in the final level of Gravewood High:
[list]
[*] A few hours of exciting and intense gameplay filled with danger and brain-blowing puzzles.
[*] Brand-new locations you haven't seen before. There will be classes, dungeons, and something else as well. 
[*] New gameplay mechanics and improvements to existing mechanics.
[*] The origin of Mr. Hyde. 
[*] The beloved Teacher will be able to teleport, break down walls, set new clever traps, and much more. 
[*] Mr. Hyde's little helpers! And no, these are not other students. Instead, they are brand-new characters in the game, getting to know them is guaranteed to cost you a few nerve cells.
[*] You can use teleportation. This feature will help you to avoid traps and the clutches of Mr. Hyde. 
[*] Two endings, which will depend entirely on your choices, so read all the notes and clues carefully. 
[/list]
The School Board promises that no student will leave Gravewood High disappointed. Mr. Hyde will personally take care of everyone and create a unique atmosphere of fun at the school. 

Add Gravewood High to your Wishlist and join our [url=https://discord.gg/exk2UsUyaV]Discord[/url] to stay tuned. Gravewood High will soon reveal its true self to the world!

[list]

notes.title: Safe Children in and Out of School: Tips From Developers
notes.notes:
We would like to share a digital brochure about child safety. Gravewood High is a fictional take on high school, evil teachers, and strange disappearances. However, the real world isn't a game and we wish that child disappearances and abductions only occurred in fiction.

"[i]Over eight million children go missing every year from around the world. We're not only the developers of a title where children disappear, we're also parents. notes.title: A vision of horror - upgrading the Teacher’s AI
notes.notes:
Dear students and concerned parents,

In the last issue of the Gravewood High PTA Newsletter, we detailed the improvements to the game's overhauled sound system. Today, we're going to look at another core aspect of the game: Mr. Hyde's vision.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37767751/726a237a8f512dc877dc8bf90a5c5852cae5a507.png[/img]

Previously, the Teacher could not only hear through walls but also reveal his otherworldly nature by seeing through small objects. Creepy, we know. Players could hide in adjacent rooms to Mr. Hyde, but hiding under objects – like benches – was very difficult... 

We have taken in your feedback and made the Teacher's vision more realistic and human-like (well, as human as he can be, given the circumstances). In fact, a lot more detection points are now used to determine your position. In the case of a face-to-face collision, Mr. Hyde will notice you within a second. If only some part of the player is visible (e.g. a leg sticking out from under a table), you'll have 2 to 3 seconds to change your position to better conceal yourself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37767751/3630a446fe6657cc9be485f82758bc7601dee9ef.png[/img]

As in real life, vertical vision is now more limited – we look straight ahead and pay much less attention to what's happening above us. But not every change introduced is a drawback - player movement has been readjusted to make moving around high places and parkour-ing onto lockers more useful, which shifts the confrontation to the vertical plane.

Finally, we've added a hearing and vision indicator to the HUD! Now, you'll know when the Teacher is aware of your presence. Knowing exactly when to flee will save you from the clutches of this educational effigy of evil.
